'''''Trail''''' was a pair of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttles]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The shuttles, along with sister group ''[[Guild]]''and the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport group]] ''[[Goode]]'', tried to defend an attack on their foothold consisting of four [[Class-C cargo container]]s [[Berm]] and [[Class-B cargo container]] [[Clip]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Compton]]''. All Rebel forces were destroyed in the battle. The battle was recreated in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]], one of whom was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
